units.source_text: 次日，大辅命妇上殿服务，源氏公子到清凉殿西厢宫女值事房来找她，

en.t: The next day, Myobu no Taifu went up to the palace for duty, and Prince Genji came to the ladies' service room in the west wing of the Seiryoden to look for her,

units.source_text: 丢给她一封信，说道：“这是昨天的回信，写这种回信，真教人费心思。”

en.t: tossed her a letter, and said, "This is the reply from yesterday. Writing this sort of answer is truly troublesome."

units.source_text: 众宫女不知道是怎么一回事，都觉得奇怪。

en.t: The other court ladies did not know what was going on, and all found it strange.

units.source_text: 公子一边走出去，一边吟道：“颜色更比红梅强，爱着红衣裳耶紫衣裳？

en.t: As the prince walked out, he recited, "Her color is deeper than the red plum; does she love the red robe or the purple robe?
...and has left behind the lovely girl of Mount Mikasa."[\[17\]](#part1335.html#m17)
Myobu understood his meaning and laughed quietly to herself.

units.source_text: 别的宫女莫名其妙，向她盘问：“你为什么独自在那里笑？”

en.t: The other court ladies were baffled and pressed her, asking, "Why are you laughing there all by yourself?"

units.source_text: 大约公子在这霜寒的早上，看见一个穿红衣裳的人鼻子冻得发红，

en.t: Perhaps on this frosty cold morning the prince saw someone in red robes whose nose had turned red from the cold,

units.source_text: 所以把那风俗歌中的句子凑合起来唱，我觉得好笑。”

en.t: and so he strung together lines from that folk song and sang them. I thought it was funny."

units.source_text: 有一个宫女不知原委，胡乱答道：“公子也太挖苦了。

en.t: One court lady, not knowing the background, answered at random, "The prince is being far too sarcastic.

units.source_text: 这里似乎并没有红鼻子的人呢。

en.t: There does not seem to be anyone with a red nose here.

units.source_text: 红鼻子的左近命妇和肥后采女难道在这里么？”

en.t: Surely the red-nosed Sakon no Myobu and Higo no Uneme are not here, are they?"
